const store = this.getWorkflowStaticData('global');
const bl = store.blacklist || {};
const sm = store.swingMeta || {};
const hc = store.healthcheck || {};

return [{
  json: {
    blacklist: {
      riskCodesCount: (bl.riskCodes || []).length,
      riskUpdatedAt: bl.riskUpdatedAt || null,
      riskCacheAge: bl.riskUpdatedAt
        ? Math.round((Date.now() - new Date(bl.riskUpdatedAt).getTime()) / 60000) + 'min ago'
        : 'never',
      riskLastError: bl.riskLastError || null,
      themeCodesCount: (bl.themeCodes || []).length,
      themeUpdatedAt: bl.themeUpdatedAt || null,
      themeFilterMode: bl.themeFilterMode || 'on',
    },
    swingMeta: {
      lastRunDate: sm.lastRunDate || null,
      lastRunAt: sm.lastRunAt || null,
      watchdogDate: sm.watchdogDate || null,
      weeklyCount: sm.weeklyCount || 0,
      weeklyStartDate: sm.weeklyStartDate || null,
      sentToday: (sm.sentTickers || []).length,
    },
    healthcheck: {
      lastSentDate: hc.lastSentDate || null,
      lastKrxStatus: hc.lastKrxStatus || null,
      lastKrxCount: hc.lastKrxCount || 0,
    },
    exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  }
}];
